ios.desc:
Boost your motivation for successful mornings with Alarmy!
The wellness app for waking up and making a better sleep cycle.

■ No.1 Alarm clock & Sleep App with 75M Users
Rated No. 1 in over 90 countries with 1.7M store reviews.

■ Waking up at once with Alarm Missions
Having trouble waking up with just a sound?
Try our variety of waking up missions:
math solving, memory games, shaking, or squats.

■ Special Alarm Clock for Heavy Sleepers
If you're a heavy sleeper who can't wake up with regular alarm clock,
our [ Anti-Snooze ] feature 
will ensure you never fall back asleep.

■ Snore & Sleep Tracker
Check if you snored last night
and whether you slept deeply using our sleep tracker,
which includes features to check the severity of snoring and your sleep cycle.

■ Quick and Deep Sleep with Calm Sleep Sounds
For those who struggle to fall asleep, 
we offer a variety of calm sleep sounds:
calm ASMR, rain sounds, white noise.

■ Regular Night Routine with Bedtime Alarms
Creating a regular night routine habit can lead to more fresh mornings.
Remind bedtime at your set schedule and turn on calm sleep sounds.
It'll boost motivation for building a habit of going to bed regularly for a better sleep routine.

--

■ Recommended for:
- Those who set multiple alarms minutes apart
- People who work early or night shifts
- Those who need to improve their sleep routine due to chronic fatigue
- People curious about whether they snore or not
- Those who need various calm sleep sounds to fall asleep easily
- Those who want to make successful morning & evening habit with the full motivation
- Anyone needs a free sleep tracker to make regular sleep cycle

--

▶ Life Hacking Tips with Alarmy

*Morning Study Routine: Study Habit
1. Choose 'Photo Mission' as the alarm dismissal mission
2. Set the cover of the book you will study as the photo mission.
3. Then, you can start studying as soon as the alarm goes off and build a habit!

*Night Sleep Routine: Habit to Combat Insomnia
1. Set your target sleeping time and set up a 'Bedtime Reminder' and wake-up alarm.
2. When it's bedtime, turn on the sleep tracker and calm sounds.
3. Maintain this routine for over 5 days to see changes in your sleep cycle, and complete your perfect night routine!

--

Alarmy is daily source of motivation for morning waking up,
but it also offers various sleeping functions.

quotes.text:
My issue was snoozing my alarm for hours which contributed both to poor quality sleep and being late to start work.

The solution was an alarm clock that makes you get out of bed and cannot be snoozed. I use Alarmy [0] and have to go downstairs and take a picture of our house thermostat every morning before it can be turned off. I'm sure there are similar apps also.

It was a horrible first fortnight, but after that it's honestly been the best thing I've done for myself in a long time. Getting up at a consistent time every day has had so many benefits.
